blocks.text: Past Simple: inkor va savol — did

11-darsda Past Simple darak gapini o'rgandik: fe'lning o'zi o'zgaradi — worked, went, saw. Inkor va savolda esa o'tgan zamonni **did** yordamchi fe'li bildiradi, asosiy fe'l esa lug'atdagi oddiy shakliga qaytadi: I went → I **didn't go**; **Did** you **go**? Bu Present Simple dagi do / does ga juda o'xshaydi (6–7-darslar): **do / does** o'rniga **did** keladi, xolos. O'zbekchada inkor `-ma-` bilan (bor**ma**dim), savol `-mi` bilan (bordingiz**mi**?) yasaladi — inglizchada bu vazifani **did** bajaradi.
**did** — barcha shaxslar uchun bitta shakl: I / you / he / she / it / we / they **didn't**. Present Simple dagidek don't / doesn't tanlash kerak emas — o'tgan zamonda bu ancha oson.

Inkor gap: **did not** (qisqa shakli — **didn't**) + fe'lning asosiy shakli. Asosiy qoida: **didn't** dan keyin fe'l hech qachon o'tgan zamonda bo'lmaydi — didn't **go** («didn't went» emas), didn't **buy**, didn't **see**. Sababi: o'tgan zamon allaqachon **did** da ko'rsatilgan, uni fe'lda ikkinchi marta ko'rsatish shart emas. To'liq shakl **did not** yozma nutqda yoki urg'u berish uchun ishlatiladi.

Savol: **Did** + ega + fe'lning asosiy shakli: **Did** you **like** it? **Did** Tom **call**? Qisqa javobda fe'l takrorlanmaydi, faqat **did / didn't** qoladi: Yes, I **did**. / No, she **didn't**. O'zbekchada esa javobda fe'l takrorlanadi: «Ko'rdingizmi? — Ha, **ko'rdim**». Shuning uchun o'zbeklar ko'pincha «Yes, I saw» deydi — inglizchada bu qisqa javob emas.
So'roq so'zlari bilan: What did you do?

So'roq so'zli savol tartibi: **so'roq so'zi + did + ega + fe'l**. O'zbekchada so'roq so'zi gapning o'rtasida turishi mumkin («Kecha **qayerga** bordingiz?»), inglizchada esa doim boshida: **Where did** you **go** yesterday? «Nima qildingiz?» — **What did** you **do**? Bu yerda do ikki marta keladi: **did** — yordamchi fe'l, **do** — asosiy fe'l («qilmoq»).

**be** fe'li inkor va savolni o'zi yasaydi (10-dars): I **wasn't** tired, **Were** you at home? Unga **did** qo'shilmaydi: «I didn't be tired», «Did you be at home?» — xato. Qanday tanlash kerak: gapda sifat, joy yoki ot bo'lsa (tired, at home, a student) — **was / were**; harakat fe'li bo'lsa (go, eat, sleep) — **did**.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I didn't went.» → I didn't **go**.; «Did you saw it?» → Did you **see** it?; «Where you went?» → Where **did** you **go**? (savolda did shart); «She didn't liked it.» → She didn't **like** it.; «Did you were at home?» → **Were** you at home?; qisqa javob «Yes, I saw.» → Yes, I **did**.
Eslab qolish: bitta gapda o'tgan zamon **faqat bir marta** ko'rsatiladi — yoki fe'lda (I **went**), yoki **did** da (I **didn't go**, **Did** you **go**?). did ko'rindimi — fe'l «toza» qoladi.
«Kim keldi?» kabi savollarda so'roq so'zi egani so'raydi va did kerak emas: **Who called** you? — 45-dars. be / have / do yordamchi fe'llarining umumiy jadvali — 23-dars, inkor shakllari — 43-dars.

examples.title: Negative: **didn't** + verb
examples.description: Inkor: **didn't** + fe'lning asosiy shakli. didn't dan keyin fe'l o'tgan zamonda bo'lmaydi: didn't **come**, didn't **know**.

sentences.text: **I didn't sleep** well last night.
Emma **didn't come** to the lesson because she was ill.
We **didn't have** time for breakfast.
My phone **didn't work** all weekend.
The shop **didn't have** any fresh bread.
Aziz **did not pass** his driving test the first time.
sentences.translation: Aziz haydovchilik imtihonini birinchi marta **topshira olmadi**.

sentences.text: Yesterday it **didn't rain**, so we had a picnic.
sentences.translation: Kecha yomg'ir **yog'madi**, shuning uchun piknik qildik.

sentences.text: Tom **didn't know** the answer, so he asked his teacher.
sentences.translation: Tom javobni **bilmasdi**, shuning uchun o'qituvchisidan so'radi.

sentences.text: Last weekend my parents **didn't go** out; they stayed at home and watched TV.
sentences.translation: O'tgan dam olish kunlari ota-onam hech qayerga **chiqishmadi**, uyda qolib televizor ko'rishdi.

sentences.text: Unfortunately, the children **didn't like** the soup.

examples.title: **didn't** ... but ...: what happened and what didn't
examples.description: Tasdiq ↔ inkor yonma-yon: nima bo'ldi va nima bo'lmadi. Darakda V2 (bought, went), inkorda — didn't + fe'l (didn't buy, didn't see).

sentences.text: I **didn't buy** a new coat; I **bought** a jacket.
Madina **phoned** me, but she **didn't leave** a message.
We **went** to the museum, but we **didn't see** the new exhibition.
The film **didn't start** at seven; it **started** at eight.
Bekzod **studied** hard, but he **didn't get** a good mark.
James **didn't order** chicken — he **ordered** fish!
My grandparents **didn't have** a car, so they **walked** everywhere.
sentences.translation: Bobom bilan buvimning mashinasi **yo'q edi**, shuning uchun hamma joyga **piyoda borishardi**.

sentences.text: In the end we **didn't take** the bus; we **got** a taxi.
Sarah **invited** all her friends, but Tom **didn't come**.
sentences.translation: Sara barcha do'stlarini **taklif qildi**, lekin Tom **kelmadi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **didn't cook** last night — she **ordered** pizza instead.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechqurun Dilnoza **ovqat qilmadi** — o'rniga pitsa **buyurtma qildi**.

examples.title: **Did** you ...? — Yes, I **did**. / No, I **didn't**.
examples.description: Savol: **Did** + ega + fe'l. Qisqa javobda fe'l takrorlanmaydi: Yes, I **did**. / No, she **didn't**. O'zbekchada esa takrorlanadi: «Ha, uxladim».

sentences.text: **Did** you sleep well? — Yes, I **did**, thanks.
**Did** Emma call you yesterday? — No, she **didn't**.
And **did** the children enjoy the circus? — Yes, they **did**. They loved it!
sentences.translation: Bolalarga sirk **yoqdimi**? — Ha, **yoqdi**. Juda xursand bo'lishdi!

sentences.text: Aziz, **did** you lock the door? — Oh no, I **didn't**!
So **did** your team win on Saturday? — No, we **didn't**. We lost 3–1.
sentences.translation: Xo'sh, shanba kuni jamoangiz **yutdimi**? — Yo'q, **yutmadik**. 3:1 hisobida yutqazdik.

sentences.text: Excuse me, **did** you drop this? — Oh yes, thank you!
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, buni siz **tushirib yubordingizmi**? — Ha, rahmat!

sentences.text: **Did** they get to the airport on time? — Yes, they **did**, but only just.
sentences.translation: Ular aeroportga o'z vaqtida **yetib borishdimi**? — Ha, **yetib borishdi**, lekin zo'rg'a.

sentences.text: Mr Smith, **did** you get my email? — Yes, I **did**. Thank you.
Last night, **did** you hear that noise outside? — No, I **didn't** hear anything.
sentences.translation: Kecha kechasi tashqaridagi shovqinni **eshitdingizmi**? — Yo'q, hech narsa **eshitmadim**.

sentences.text: What about Bekzod and Madina? **Did** they come to the wedding? — Bekzod **did**, but Madina **didn't**.
sentences.translation: Bekzod bilan Madina-chi? To'yga **kelishdimi**? — Bekzod **keldi**, Madina **kelmadi**.

examples.title: What **did** you do? Where **did** you go?
examples.description: So'roq so'zi + **did** + ega + fe'l. «Nima qildingiz?» — What **did** you **do**? (did — yordamchi, do — asosiy fe'l).

sentences.text: What **did** you do at the weekend? — We **went** to the mountains.
Where **did** you buy that lovely scarf?
What **did** the doctor say? — She said it was nothing serious.
sentences.translation: Shifokor **nima dedi**? — Hech qanday jiddiy narsa yo'q, dedi.

sentences.text: Where **did** Tom and Sarah go for their honeymoon?
sentences.translation: Tom bilan Sara asal oyiga **qayerga borishdi**?

sentences.text: Who **did** you see at the party?
What time **did** your plane land?
Which hotel **did** you choose in the end?
So, Madina, what **did** you think of the film?
And where **did** you learn such good English?
Dilnoza, what **did** your brother bring from London?

examples.title: When, why, how **did** ...?
examples.description: Vaqt, sabab, usul va narxni so'rash: When **did** ...? Why **did** ...? How **did** ...? How much **did** ...? Inkor savol: Why **didn't** you ...?

sentences.text: When **did** you arrive in London?
Why **did** Aziz leave so early?
How **did** you get to the airport — by bus or by taxi?
How much **did** you pay for these shoes?
When **did** your grandparents move to Tashkent?
sentences.translation: Bobom bilan buvim Toshkentga **qachon ko'chib kelishgan**?

sentences.text: Why **did** the teacher get angry with you?
How long **did** the journey take?
But why **didn't** you tell me about the problem?
Emma, when **did** you first visit Uzbekistan?
And how **did** your parents meet?

examples.title: **Was** it ...? or **Did** it ...?
examples.description: be (sifat, joy, ot bilan) — **was / were**: I wasn't hungry, Were you at work? Harakat fe'li bilan — **did**: I didn't eat, Did you go? «Did you be» deyilmaydi.

sentences.text: I **wasn't** hungry, so I **didn't eat** anything.
sentences.translation: **Qornim och emasdi**, shuning uchun hech narsa **yemadim**.

sentences.text: **Were** you at work on Monday? — No, I **wasn't**. I **didn't feel** well.
**Did** you like the hotel? — Yes, it **was** very comfortable.
The film **wasn't** very good, and we **didn't stay** till the end.
**Was** the museum open? — No, it **wasn't**, so we **didn't go** in.
sentences.translation: Muzey **ochiqmidi**? — Yo'q, **yopiq edi**, shuning uchun ichkariga **kirmadik**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **was** tired after work, but he **didn't go** to bed early.
sentences.translation: Bekzod ishdan keyin **charchagan edi**, lekin erta **yotmadi**.

sentences.text: Where **were** you yesterday? I **didn't see** you at the meeting.
**Did** Sarah enjoy her birthday? — Yes, she **was** really happy.
sentences.translation: Sara tug'ilgan kunidan **mamnun bo'ldimi**? — Ha, juda **xursand edi**.

sentences.text: It **was** a nice day, but we **didn't want** to go out.
Why **were** you late? **Did** you miss the bus?

examples.title: Dialogue: Aziz's first day at work
examples.description: Suhbatda savol, qisqa javob va inkor: How was ...? Did you ...? What did you do? — I didn't ...

sentences.text: — So, Aziz, how **was** your first day at the new job?
sentences.translation: — Xo'sh, Aziz, yangi ishdagi birinchi kuning **qanday o'tdi**?

sentences.text: — Not bad, but I **didn't sleep** much the night before.
sentences.translation: — Yomon emas, lekin oldingi kechasi deyarli **uxlamadim**.

sentences.text: — Oh dear! **Did** you get there on time?
sentences.translation: — Voy! U yerga o'z vaqtida **yetib bordingmi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, I **did**. I **left** home at seven and **took** a taxi.
sentences.translation: — Ha, **yetib bordim**. Uydan yettida **chiqdim** va **taksida bordim**.

sentences.text: — And what **did** you do all day?
— I **met** my new colleagues and **learnt** a lot about the company.
sentences.translation: — Yangi hamkasblarim bilan **tanishdim** va kompaniya haqida ko'p narsa **bilib oldim**.

sentences.text: — **Did** your boss say anything about the salary?
— No, she **didn't**, and I **didn't ask**.
— Where **did** you have lunch? In the office?
— No, we **went** to a little café round the corner. It **was** great!

examples.title: Mixed: **Did** you ...? — No, I **didn't**, but ...
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: savol, qisqa javob, inkor va tuzatish — bitta gapda bir nechta shakl.

sentences.text: **Did** you buy milk? — No, I **didn't**, but I **bought** some bread.
**Did** Madina go to Bukhara by train? — No, she **didn't**. She **flew**.
sentences.translation: Madina Buxoroga poyezdda **bordimi**? — Yo'q, poyezdda **bormadi**. Samolyotda **uchdi**.

sentences.text: Emma **didn't call** — she **sent** a text message instead.
We **didn't win** the match, but we **played** very well.
What **did** you get for your birthday? — My parents **gave** me a bike.
sentences.translation: Tug'ilgan kuningizga **nima sovg'a qilishdi**? — Ota-onam velosiped **sovg'a qilishdi**.

sentences.text: Last week I **didn't go** to the gym once — I **was** too busy.
sentences.translation: O'tgan hafta sport zaliga bir marta ham **bormadim** — juda **band edim**.

sentences.text: Why **did** James sell his car? — He **didn't need** it any more.
sentences.translation: Jeyms nega mashinasini **sotdi**? — Unga endi **kerak emas edi**.

sentences.text: **Did** the shop have your size? — No, so I **didn't buy** the jeans.
sentences.translation: Do'konda sizning o'lchamingiz **bormidi**? — Yo'q, shuning uchun jinsini **olmadim**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **didn't do** his homework, so the teacher **wasn't** happy.
sentences.translation: Bekzod uy vazifasini **qilmadi**, shuning uchun o'qituvchi **norozi bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: How **did** the interview go? — Well, I **didn't answer** every question, but it **went** OK.
sentences.translation: Suhbat **qanday o'tdi**? — Hamma savollarga ham **javob bermadim**, lekin **yomon o'tmadi**.
